ModMetaData.name: Kid Apparel Expanded
ModMetaData.author: Goblins4Lyfe
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c4zpSbm.png[/img] Kid Apparel Expanded is about giving child pawns more things to wear besides the limited vanilla items. It should give the kids more personality as they grow up, or even make them more useful if you're going the child soldier route.
Armor and clothing is distributed among existing technologies, the kid clothes will be discovered alongside the adult versions of the clothes in your research tree.
This mod will also contain items from DLCs in the near future, which includes Royalty, Ideology, and Biotech. Odyssey doesn't have any items to add, as it only has the vacsuit and helmet. Old power armor helmets are intended to be worn by kids now too.
Stats of the kid apparel are similar to the adult versions, but with a few differences. The mass is halved along with the ingredients cost, with four fifths of the work required to create them. The stats for protection and temperature are still the same. [img]https://i.imgur.com/6q827VG.png[/img] - Kid Button-Down Shirt - Kid Duster - Kid Flak Helmet - Kid Flak Jacket - Kid Flak Pants - Kid Flak Vest - Kid Jacket - Kid Marine Armor - Kid Pants (vanilla item, now visible on pawns) - Kid Plate Armor - Kid Psychic Foil Helmet - Kid Recon Armor - Kid Squire Armor (plate armor, but for kids!) - Kid War Mask - More to come soon! [img]https://i.imgur.com/D7eihUF.png[/img] Version 1.0.0 -Initial release of Kid Apparel Expanded, fourteen items added (thirteen with kid pants now visible when worn) from adult pawn's core game outfits and armors. [img]https://i.imgur.com/zdJaT6a.png[/img] -Big thanks to BlackMarket420 for their excellent artwork as usual, and to my friends who helped me test the mod and gave feedback on my ideas for it. -And special thanks of course, to the rimworld discord's modding channel, for all the veteran modders who gave me advice and instructions when I was struggling a lot to make this mod. -Finally, amazing thanks to YOU! For trying out this mod! I appreciate it! [img]https://i.imgur.com/J5O2Shc.png[/img] We don't have any questions yet, but if I get any, I'll add them here.
Want to support me as I start my mod making journey? I've got a ko-fi and it helps me out a lot, to spend more time learning how to make mods, and to pay BlackMarket420 for their artwork. https://ko-fi.com/junkyardjoe0607
